guidelines: Students must carry their university ID card to the examination hall.
Mobile phones and electronic devices are strictly prohibited during exams.
Students should arrive at least 15 minutes before the exam starts.
No student will be allowed entry 30 minutes after the exam begins.
Use of unfair means will result in immediate expulsion from the exam.

dressCodeViolations: Wearing a sleeveless, hanging t-shirt or chemise
Wearing a wrack, ragged or slashed jeans/trousers
Wearing dirty clothes or half-pant or skirt
Putting on slippers of ordinary type
libraryCode: Library members must bear library cards while in the library.
Handing over of the library card is absolutely prohibited.
Folders, files, personal books and all kinds of bags are not allowed in the library.
Members are entitled to issue 02 (two) different books at a time for ten days.
Library remains open from 8:30 AM to 8:30 PM except holidays.
On expiry of due date, TK 10/- will be charged per day for each issue.
Silence must be maintained in the reading room.
No food is allowed except fresh drinking water.
In case of losing any book, a member must replace it or pay three times the market price.
majorOffenses: Any activity that impedes a student's right to attend classes
Any act that disturbs peace and order in class or campus
Possessing or taking any sort of drug
Physical assault and/or injuries to anyone on campus
Any sort of forgery or falsification
minorOffenses: Entering campus or classroom without wearing ID card
Smoking inside the classroom or campus
Manners unbecoming of a university student
Misuse or improper use of university properties
Acts causing panic or confusion in campus

policies.title: Attendance Requirement
policies.content: A student must have a minimum of 60% attendance in a course to be eligible for the final examination. Students failing to meet this requirement will be marked as 'Not Eligible' for the final exam.

policies.title: Midterm Examination
policies.content: Midterm exams carry 30% of the total marks. These are conducted during the middle of each semester as per the academic calendar. There is no supplementary midterm exam.

policies.title: Final Examination
policies.content: Final exams carry 40% of total marks. A student must pass the final examination separately with a minimum of 40% marks to pass the course overall.

policies.title: Continuous Assessment
policies.content: The remaining 30% marks are distributed among class attendance (10%), assignments/quizzes (10%), and class participation/presentations (10%).

policies.title: Retake & Improvement Policy
policies.content: Students who fail a course (grade F) must retake the course. Students may improve a grade by retaking the course, and the higher grade will be considered for CGPA calculation.

policies.title: Academic Dishonesty
policies.content: Any form of cheating, plagiarism, or unfair means during examination will lead to immediate cancellation of the exam. Repeat offenders face suspension or expulsion from the university.

policies.title: Exam Deferral
policies.content: Students may apply for exam deferral with valid documentation (medical certificate, etc.) within 3 working days of the missed exam. Deferred exams are scheduled at the end of the semester.

steps.title: Visit Student Portal
steps.desc: Log in to the PCIU Student Portal using your Student ID and password.

steps.title: Navigate to Results
steps.desc: Go to 'Academic' → 'Semester Results' from the dashboard menu.

steps.title: Select Semester
steps.desc: Choose the semester and year to view your grades and GPA.

steps.title: Download Transcript
steps.desc: Click 'Download' to save your unofficial transcript as PDF.
